user.title: Overview Extras
user.description: Adds lights-on glow and badges, presence, room power, open doors and windows, media and alerts to the built-in Overview's room cards. After adding, refresh your browser and the mobile app. Use Configure to change settings.

abort.already_configured: Overview Extras is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Overview Extras is already set up.

init.title: Overview Extras
init.description: Changes apply after you save and refresh the browser or app.

room_sources.title: Room sources
room_sources.description: Pick a room to choose which entities feed its temperature, humidity, power, presence and lights.

room.title: {area} sources
room.description: Everything in {area} is included by default, and new entities added to the room are included automatically. Remove any you don't want. Temperature and humidity are averaged, and power is totalled.

settings.title: General settings
settings.description: Changes apply after you refresh the browser or app.

data.show_glow: Glow room cards when lights are on
data.show_presence: Use occupancy and presence sensors for the presence icon
data.area_strip: Status strip at the top of room pages
data.badges: Badges on room cards (in priority order)
data.set_primary: Use the room averages as each room's temperature and humidity
data.update_interval: How often room averages and power totals update

data_description.max_badges: Room cards are small; extra badges are dropped.
data_description.set_primary: Only fills rooms where you haven't chosen a temperature or humidity sensor yourself in the room's settings.
data_description.update_interval: In seconds. Changes in between are combined into one update, which keeps database writes down. Occupancy and lights always update immediately.

abort.no_sources: {area} has no temperature, humidity, power, presence or light entities yet.
